title: Travel: John Lennon – London to Brive-la-Gaillarde | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from London to Bordeaux in France on 18 April 1971.

They were attempting to locate Ono’s daughter Kyoko, whom they had last seen in August 1970. Lennon and Ono were hoping to obtain custody of the seven-year-old, and had received a lead that she was living in France with her father Tony Cox and his wife Melinda.

Lennon and Ono flew to Bordeaux with their assistant Dan Richter, and from there travelled to Brive-la-Gaillarde. They stayed there for only one day, and moved on to Mallorca the next day.
